rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Official Gazette special extra issue No. 52 (号外特第52号) dated Monday 11 November 2024 prints, under 人事異動 / 内閣, the appointment of 石破茂 as Prime Minister (内閣総理大臣に任命する), followed by the appointments of the ministers of state.

locator.item: 内閣総理大臣に任命する

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Page 2 of the same issue closes the day's appointments with (以上十一月十一日) and, under ○内閣総理大臣及び国務大臣退官, states that, 石破茂 having been appointed Prime Minister on the 11th of that month (本月十一日), 石破茂, Prime Minister of the first Ishiba cabinet (第一次石破内閣の内閣総理大臣石破茂), and the ministers of state each lost their office (それぞれその地位を失った).

locator.section: ○内閣総理大臣及び国務大臣退官
